close_reason: Added PrincipalCalendarsCapability to capability.rs with 4 fields per §2.1; re-exported from lib.rs; 4 tests covering null/non-null accountId and round-trip
description:
**What:** Add PrincipalCalendarsCapability to capability.rs. Draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §2.1 defines the value of Principal.capabilities["urn:ietf:params:jmap:calendars"]. Fields: accountId (Id|null), mayGetAvailability (Boolean), mayShareWith (Boolean), calendarAddress (String).

**Algorithm:**
1. Add to capability.rs:
   #[non_exhaustive]
   #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
   #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
   pub struct PrincipalCalendarsCapability {
       pub account_id: Option<Id>,       // Id|null, no skip_serializing_if
       pub may_get_availability: bool,
       pub may_share_with: bool,
       pub calendar_address: String,
   }
2. Re-export from lib.rs.
3. Add round-trip serde tests: accountId null and non-null cases.
4. Run cargo test -p jmap-calendars-types.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- 4 fields with correct wire names.
- accountId serializes as null when None.
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-types exits 0.
title: Add PrincipalCalendarsCapability struct (calendars-26 §2.1)
